title: Knit Yarn Unravel
description: Unravel chunky woven yarn models strand by strand—match spool colors cleanly to untangle every vibrant thread in ultra-satisfying puzzle levels.
controls: Tap colored yarn pins and spools in the right sequence to unravel matching wool layers without jamming the holding slots.

zh-CN.title: 拆个毛线
zh-CN.description: 抖音爆火解压拆毛线闯关：按颜色顺序一根根抽丝剥茧拆掉毛线织物，卷满同色线轴一秒强迫症狂喜！
zh-CN.controls: 点击对应颜色的毛线节点按顺序拆解并收入上方同色线轴，合理规划空位清光全部毛线。
